decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the carrier's record shows the parcel was delivered to the cardholder and signed for in her name. TXN-007946 is an 83.05 EUR purchase at Willowmere Apparel on card CRD-000161, posted on 2026-10-02. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 26 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000028 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-05. The dispute was opened 23 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period had passed (goods-not-received-wait). The carrier's delivery record DOC-000029 shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-10-05 to the cardholder's address in Utrecht and signed for by O. Eriksen. The cardholder profile names Olga Eriksen of Utrecht, so the address and the signature match her. Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, the goods are therefore treated as received and the dispute is declined. Neither document contained instructions addressed to whoever handles the dispute.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Willowmere Apparel order was delivered to your address in Utrecht on 2026-10-05 and signed for by O. Eriksen. Under our policy, goods delivered to your address and signed for in your name are treated as received.
